It does not say that an install or upgrade fails, is gated or hits an unmet precondition. An OperatorHub-based environment that does nothing keeps running v1.16.5 and simply gets no newer releases through that channel. So upgrade-blocked (mandatory work) over-claims; this is a review-class behavior-change.

correction.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages; v1.16.5 is the last release on OperatorHub (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io). Environments that install cert-manager through OperatorHub stay on v1.16.5 and receive no 1.17.0 or later releases through that channel; nothing is stated to fail.

consequence.statement: An environment that installs or updates cert-manager through OperatorHub keeps working on v1.16.5, but no longer receives new cert-manager releases (1.17.0 or later) through OperatorHub, because v1.16.5 is the last release published there.
consequence.remediation: If you need cert-manager releases after v1.16.5, check how cert-manager is installed and plan to switch to a distribution channel other than OperatorHub.
